title: Cad Play Production Chrome Parity
description: The arc command doesn't preview correctly (no curve rendering for arc/circle-outline preview kinds) and produces wrong output (kernel reads radiusPoint instead of start)
summary: Fixed CAD play Selection details panel staying empty/stale: SidePanel no longer memoizes resolved tree config (re-resolve on each render so CallbackTreePanelDefinition reads fresh snapshot); CAD play uses cadPlayChromeSnapshotRef with stable panel tab definitions and runtime.notifyChrome() on snapshot publish; buildCadPlaySelectionInspectorChildren shows labeled target rows instead of blank keyValue items.
